message.content:
Here’s a balanced mix of compound and isolation moves that target all the major muscles in your lower body—quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves, and core stability: | # | Exercise | Primary Muscles | How to Do It (Key Points) | |---|----------|-----------------|---------------------------| | 1 | **Back Squat** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings, core | • Feet shoulder‑width, toes slightly out.
• Keep chest up, back neutral.
• Lower until thighs parallel or below.
• Drive through heels to stand. | | 2 | **Front Squat** | Quads, glutes, core | • Same stance as back squat.
• Hold bar on front deltoids, elbows high.
• Keep torso upright; deeper range of motion. | | 3 | **Romanian Deadlift** | Hamstrings, glutes, lower back | • Light barbell or dumbbells.
• Hinge at hips, knees slightly bent.
• Keep bar close to legs, feel stretch in hamstrings. | | 4 | **Bulgarian Split Squat** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | • One foot forward, rear foot elevated on bench.
• Lower until front thigh parallel.
• Push through front heel. | | 5 | **Hip Thrust / Glute Bridge** | Glutes, hamstrings | • Barbell across hips, feet flat.
• Lift hips until body forms straight line.
• Squeeze glutes at top. | | 6 | **Walking Lunge** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | • Step forward, lower until both knees ~90°.
• Alternate legs, keep torso upright. | | 7 | **Step‑Up** | Quads, glutes | • Use a sturdy box or bench.
• Step onto box with one leg, drive through heel. | | 8 | **Calf Raise (Standing or Seated)** | Calves | • Raise heels off floor, pause at top.
• Full range of motion, slow eccentric phase. | | 9 | **Leg Press** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | • Adjust seat so knees form ~90° angle.
• Push through heels, avoid locking knees. | |10 | **Cable Kickback** | Glutes | • Attach ankle cuff, extend leg backward.
• Keep knee slightly bent, focus on glute contraction. | ### Sample Weekly Routine (3–4 days) | Day | Warm‑up | Main Lifts | Accessory | Cool‑down | |-----|---------|------------|-----------|-----------| | 1 | 5‑min light cardio + dynamic stretches | Back Squat (4×6) | Walking Lunge (3×12 each leg) | Stretch quads, hamstrings | | 2 | 5‑min light cardio + hip mobility drills | Romanian Deadlift (4×8) | Calf Raise (4×15) | Foam roll calves, glutes | | 3 | 5‑min light cardio + leg swings | Hip Thrust (4×8) | Leg Press (3×10) | Stretch glutes, quads | | 4 | Optional active recovery or rest | Front Squat (3×5) | Cable Kickback (3×12) | Stretch hamstrings, calves | ### Tips for Progression 1. **Progressive Overload** – Add 2–5 lb each week or increase reps before adding weight. 2. **Form First** – Prioritize technique over heavier loads to avoid injury. 3. **Recovery** – Allow 48 h between heavy squats/leg presses; use foam rolling or massage. 4. **Nutrition** – Adequate protein (0.8–1.2 g/kg) supports muscle repair. Feel free to swap or rotate exercises to keep training fresh and hit all angles. Happy lifting!
